real_task: Determine whether Session 097's real connector publication preserved the contemporaneous, repository-auditable operation ordering and exact side-effect object IDs required by DEC-0036.
observed_problem: Session 097 reports a verified branch/main tree and fast-forward, but DEC-0036 requires tracked operation-order receipts and exact side-effect IDs before connector utility can be reassessed.
problem_trace: docs/SESSIONS.md Session 097, DEC-0036, commit ff25f1dc8863c1bc21259a9d22aad9265bfc9b99 and its tracked tree.
baseline: Accept the session summary plus immutable Git state: final commit/tree identity is independently checkable, while ordering, pre-tree blob checks and ref-update parameters are not yet established by a named tracked receipt.
hypothesis: Three read-only repository inspections will find tracked evidence for all four publication facts: returned blob-OID comparisons before tree creation, tree creation only after all matches, branch commit/tree/parent, and force-disabled main update with an expected old SHA.
minimum_useful_effect: Support 4/4 facts from tracked contemporaneous evidence and immutable Git identities without relying on the later summary alone.
quality_control: Count immutable Git state only for object identity/ancestry; count operation order and connector parameters only when a tracked contemporaneous receipt records them. Absence of a receipt is not proof an operation did or did not occur.
overhead: Include fresh clone, mandatory reads, branch audit, gate/checkpoint/coverage, three inspections, documentation, LAB tests, site build, checkpoint refresh and publication.
stop_condition: Stop after three task-specific read-only inspections. Do not perform connector writes, recreate bad objects, alter publication code or infer temporal facts from final Git state.

facts.fact: returned blob OIDs were compared with expected OIDs before tree creation
facts.reason: No tracked Session 097 operation receipt records returned blob OIDs or their comparison order.

facts.fact: the remote tree was created only after every blob matched
facts.reason: Final Git state cannot establish temporal order and no tracked receipt records the create-tree boundary.

facts.fact: the published branch commit has the expected tree and parent
facts.reason: Immutable Git state resolves commit ff25f1dc8863c1bc21259a9d22aad9265bfc9b99 to tree 15cccf20a86b2505b246616c7419a20e847489fb and parent de904b610fb45d0e80cc8c0b0f7ddfff43430945; the agent branch points to that commit.

facts.fact: main was updated with force disabled and expected old SHA lease
facts.reason: Current ancestry proves the commit reached main, but immutable Git state does not encode force=false or the expected_sha request parameter.

decision_reason: A second evaluation after Session 094's positive record again supports only 1/4 required facts. Session 096 was inconclusive and Session 099 is negative, so restart-safety reaches the policy parking threshold. Retain OID checks as prudent practice, freeze publication code and reopen only for a new natural write with a tracked contemporaneous operation receipt.
failures: The first bookkeeping inspection assumed handoff/claims.json was an object with a claims key; it is a top-level list. Reading the actual shape corrected the inspection without changing the experiment result.
limitations: The evaluation does not claim that Session 097 skipped any safety step or that its final publication was incorrect. It shows only that the repository cannot independently audit three temporal/parameter facts. No time, token, LLM-performance or generic agent-utility claim is made.
